in_marathi.name: Meghraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Clouds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meghraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meghraj is the name of the god of clouds in Hindu mythology. He is also known as Indra's chariot, as he is believed to transport Indra, the god of rain, across the sky.
